title: KaaS release manifest (KAAS-DEPLOY-001)
description: The immutable handoff from GitHub (which tests, builds and publishes) to Operations (which deploys). One source revision; every deployable image by digest. A tag is never a valid reference here: a tag is a mutable pointer, and a deployment that resolved one could run an image this revision never produced.

revision.description: The full 40-character git commit every image below was built from, and which each carries as its org.opencontainers.image.revision label.

api.description: Control plane; also the migrator (kaas-api migrate) and the deploy check (kaas-api deploy-check).

karate-engine.description: The sandboxed engine the runner launches (KAAS_RUNNER_ENGINE_IMAGE).

egress-proxy.description: The allowlist egress proxy the runner launches (KAAS_RUNNER_EGRESS_PROXY_IMAGE).

security-probe.description: The trusted probe the runner's attestation refresh runs on the execution host (KAAS_RUNNER_PROBE_IMAGE).
